title: [Contoso Demo Data] Refresh Common G/L mappings before Manufacturing demo setup
summary: Manufacturing demo setup now refreshes Common G/L account mappings at the start to prevent failures when non-Premium demo data was previously generated in the session.
key_points: Calls existing Create Common GL Account codeunit at the beginning of Manufacturing setup
Fixes issue where Manufacturing fails to find Raw Materials account when Common mappings are empty
Adds regression test to verify Manufacturing restores localized mappings without replacing existing accounts
Supports localizations that use blank mappings
No schema or public contract changes
